* Official Classification: Formally designated under Garden Residential Area G (RG) regulations by the Bahrain Urban Planning authority.
* Permitted Developments: Exclusively optimized for building low-density independent houses, luxury separate villas, attached villas, or premium garden flats.
* Building Footprint: Maximum building coverage is capped strictly at 55% of the total land plot area.
* Height Allowance: Development permits allow for a maximum height of 2 stories (up to 10 meters, or 11.5 meters if including a basement level).
* On-Site Parking: Regulations require the integration of a minimum of two dedicated car parking spaces inside the plot per residential unit.
* Setback Requirements: Strict architectural recoils/setbacks are enforced from all structural sides to preserve privacy and garden spacing.
